As the 2026 World Cup gradually draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) will reignite its action tomorrow on Apple TV, while Apple Maps, Apple Sports, Apple Fitness+ and other platforms simultaneously launch a host of related features. Details are as follows.

MLS Returns on Apple TV

Apple today announced the return of MLS matches, with six games set to take place over the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs Toronto FC (7:30 PM ET)
  • Chicago Fire vs Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM ET)
  • Seattle Sounders FC vs Portland Timbers (10:30 PM ET)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs Los Angeles FC (10:15 PM ET)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a range of new MLS-related features across its platforms, including a brand-new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode features German football legend Thomas Müller, who shares the efforts he made before his career took off, and how he embraces the challenges of major life transitions.

Apple Music will also roll out a number of exclusive playlists personally curated by star players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander Da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati, as well as themed playlists from Eastern and Western Conference sides such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC and Orlando City SC.

On Apple Maps, Apple will introduce "Match Day Guides" produced by MLS clubs and "City Guides" created by players themselves, offering fans recommendations for matchday restaurants, local highlights and detailed stadium information.

For those who rely on the Apple Sports app, users can stay up to date with the latest league information through real-time scores, standings, live text updates of matches, lineups and team statistics.

Finally, Apple said:

MLS matches are now available to Apple TV subscribers free of charge in over 100 countries and regions worldwide. Apple will also bring fans exclusive content, as well as coverage of all the season's cup competitions and playoffs.

To read more about Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please click here.

Apple TV is priced at US$12.99 per month, or subscribers can opt for the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a wide selection of popular series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
